highlights: Cancelled Install and close requests no longer trigger an installer later; Free updates remain available after a failed trial request.
Phone & MCP keeps a separate Abort allowance and lets you read every Job Review warning and operation across pages.
grblHAL whole-number settings keep their intended values; reconnecting no longer leaves an old Wake error on the new connection.
Line Art is the free tracing option; the other tracing modes ask for desktop Pro access.
Large projects save in the background, with cancellation preserving your unsaved edits.
Material recipes fit MCP responses, and closing a dialog returns focus to the control that opened it.
